approval.note: learning point ve craftsman uyarilari yanlis pozitif: cekim/notasyon farki (be said to have done, craftsmen); t -bowl STT hatasi tea bowl olarak duzeltildi

segments.text: In the 15th century, a Japanese ruler is said to have broken his favorite tea bowl.
segments.englishExplanation: In the 15th century, a Japanese ruler reportedly broke his favorite tea bowl.
segments.turkishExplanation: 15. yüzyılda, Japon bir hükümdarın en sevdiği çay kasesini kırdığı söylenir.

segments.text: He sent it away for repair, but it came back held together with ugly metal stables.
segments.englishExplanation: He sent the bowl to be fixed, but it returned repaired with unattractive metal staples.
segments.turkishExplanation: Onarılması için gönderdi, ancak çirkin metal zımbalarla tutturulmuş olarak geri geldi.

segments.text: Disappointed, he asked local craftsmen to find a better solution.
segments.englishExplanation: Unhappy with the ugly repair, he asked local artisans to find a better solution.
segments.turkishExplanation: Hayal kırıklığına uğrayarak, yerel zanaatkarlardan daha iyi bir çözüm bulmalarını istedi.

segments.text: What they came up with was a lacquer mixed with powdered gold, which turned every crack
segments.englishExplanation: The craftsmen created a gold-infused lacquer that transformed every crack...
segments.turkishExplanation: Ortaya çıkardıkları şey, her bir çatlağı dönüştüren, altın tozuyla karıştırılmış bir cilaydı

segments.text: This is how the art of Kintsugi was born.
segments.englishExplanation: This historic event marked the birth of the art of Kintsugi.

segments.text: What makes it remarkable is not the gold itself, but the idea behind it.
segments.englishExplanation: The real beauty of this art comes from its philosophy rather than the gold itself.
segments.turkishExplanation: Onu olağanüstü kılan şey altının kendisi değil, arkasındaki fikirdir.

segments.text: It is the damage, not the perfection, that tells the object's story.
segments.englishExplanation: An object's story is expressed through its visible flaws rather than perfection.
segments.turkishExplanation: Nesnenin hikayesini anlatan şey mükemmellik değil, aldığı hasardır.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to report past events that are believed or rumored to have happened without direct proof.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Geçmişte yaşandığı söylenen veya rivayet edilen olayları aktarırken kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: The castle is said to have been built in the 12th century.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To think of, produce, or devise a solution, idea, or plan.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir fikir, çözüm veya plan üretmek, akıl etmek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: They came up with a great solution to the problem.

quiz.question: It is the damage, not the perfection, ______ tells the object's story.

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("be said to have done") segment 1'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
"craftsman" transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — çekim/inflection farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
